# Mistfall Hunter Classes

> Mistfall Hunter Classes is a fan-made guide and build planner for comparing roles, risk, and build direction before a run.

## Core Content
- [Main planner](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/): Interactive Mistfall Hunter class planner and role overview.
- [Classes guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/classes/): Class role profiles, risk notes, and beginner direction.
- [Build planner](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/build-planner/): Dedicated planner page for build-intent searches.
- [Price guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/price/): Steam price snapshot, launch discount, buyer checks, and refund-source guidance.
- [Steam info](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/steam/): Official Steam facts and safe source links.

## Common Resources
- [About](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/about/): Editorial policy and source handling.
- [Contact](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/contact/): Correction and feedback contact route.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/privacy-policy/): Privacy and planner data handling.
- [Terms of Service](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/terms-of-service/): Fan-site disclaimer and usage terms.

## Latest Updates
- [Main planner](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/): Updated in July 2026 with multilingual routes, class planner copy, sitemap, and language switching.
